fields.Name: T340 - Version History App Load and Labels Landing
fields.Description: Exercises the custom Version History app entry and VersionHistoryLabelsResource's own KPI computation (computeStats) plus card/list rendering — not the generic entity grid path.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and select 'Version History'. The default 'Labels' surface should open. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Confirm the 'Version Labels' page renders with its header, a 'Create Label' button, four KPI stat cards, and either a list of labels or a valid empty state. Seeing the page render is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Version History app opens and the 'Version Labels' page renders with a header and a Create Label button
Four KPI stat cards are visible (Total Labels, Active, Archived, Restored) each showing a numeric value
Either a card/list of version labels OR a 'No labels found' empty state is shown (data-agnostic)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
